host.description: IP address the exporter listens on. Use 0.0.0.0 to listen on all interfaces.

port.description: Port number the exporter exposes Prometheus metrics on.

dnsmasq_leasefile.description: Absolute path to dnsmasq's lease database file, typically /var/lib/dnsmasq/dnsmasq.leases.

dnsmasq_dhcp_stats_file.description: Optional absolute path to dnsmasq's DHCP stats file (e.g., /var/lib/dnsmasq/dnsmasq-dhcp-stats). Leave empty if not available.

scrape_timeout.description: Maximum time (seconds) allowed for a single scrape of dnsmasq stats before timing out.

enable_verbose.description: Enable verbose debug logging for troubleshooting.

extra_flags.description: Additional command-line flags to pass to the exporter (e.g., ['--log-json']).

items.description: A single command-line flag or argument (without leading '--' if implied by the exporter, but typically include full flags like '--log-json' or '--metrics-path=/metrics').
